text: The Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") provides comprehensive operations and maintenance services to Toronto Transit Commission ("TTC") for its commuter parking facilities pursuant to a parking services agreement ("Agreement"). This arrangement has been continuous since 2002. The most recent ten (10)-year contract expired June 30, 2017. This report seeks the TPA Board's formal endorsement of continuing the arrangement under the same terms and conditions, for the period ending June 30, 2018, pending finalization of negotiations between the parties on a long term extension.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Directed staff to extend the expired parking services agreement with the Toronto Transit Commission ("TTC") for operation and maintenance of the Commission's commuter parking facilities, until June 30, 2018, with no other change to the terms and conditions, to allow time to finalize a renewed agreement with TTC.
